_comment: TEST-ONLY well-known keys for the localnet genesis baked into the world-contracts snapshot image. Derived from the public test mnemonic 'test test test test test test test test test test test junk' (ed25519, m/44'/784'/<account>'/0'/0'). These private keys are PUBLIC and committed on purpose so downstream builders/services can act on the pre-deployed contracts. NEVER use these accounts on a real/public network or fund them with real assets.

ADMIN.role: Deploys the world packages and is an admin in the AdminACL.

PLAYER_A.role: Genesis-funded test player, used by the SDK integration tests.
